status: Prospective discovery diagnostic; no fitted outcome asserted
question: Can a learned reusable vector computation explain multiple native MLP uses beyond sharing the architecture's generic activation function?

source.extraction_role: Only original native input/write arrays are reused. No affine, SVD or Copy replacement is the proposed learned rule.
source.evaluation_status: Disjoint from these fitting passages, but already examined in prior project experiments. This panel is not untouched confirmatory evidence.

discovery_and_transfer.discovery: Fit candidate operations and native bindings jointly on discovery-use training rows. Select body structures and snapshots using training evidence only.
discovery_and_transfer.transfer: Freeze the complete discovered body, including its numerical coefficients, offsets and internal scales. Fit only explicitly listed transfer-use bindings on the transfer-use training rows. Record body identity and trainable operator IDs before and after fitting.
discovery_and_transfer.scope: This split is a finite experiment on four uses, not a claim that the model consists of four independent algorithms. Full-dimensional arguments are allowed; argument count is not payload dimension.

required_controls: Original native computation with the same interfaces and evaluation episodes
Independent per-use fits with the same primitive inventory and reported fitting compute
Primitive-only sharing, explicitly labelled architectural reuse when it only recovers the already shared activation architecture
For learned shared numerical geometry: frozen random and frozen one-use-native bodies with identical binding capacity and optimizer settings

gauge_checks.square_body: An invertible shared square matrix before a freely learned reader can be absorbed into that reader. Its existence alone is not evidence of discovered organization.
gauge_checks.overcomplete_body: A shared 3072-by-768 reader with paid per-use 768-by-768 input bindings preserves the native nonlinear width. Its overcomplete row relations cannot generally be removed by an invertible input-coordinate change. This is a numerical-structure hypothesis, not automatically an interpreted algorithm.
gauge_checks.permutations: Native hidden-unit ordering is arbitrary. Failure under one ordering is not evidence that reusable structure is absent.
gauge_checks.signs: GELU(-z)=GELU(z)-z permits sign changes to be absorbed only when the representation also supplies the required adjustable affine contribution. Do not silently quotient out unavailable operations.

measurements.proposal_objective: Maximum across use and row of native-output Euclidean error divided by that use's fixed native RMS output norm. A pooled denominator is a different objective and must be labelled as such.
measurements.fitting_arithmetic: Record the explicit product arithmetic and all optimizer settings. Float32 proposal products are permitted; final decoded fidelity uses the existing float64 evaluation path.
measurements.cost: Complete serialized-artifact C32, including bindings, body literals, wiring, retained native computation and native-control mappings. No hypothetical sharing discount.
measurements.local: Fixed native pure-MLP contribution boundaries on identical native parent states. Do not dilute the scale with an unchanged residual skip.
measurements.run: Autonomous saved-byte execution on the declared native intervention family. Report maximum group-mean per-token KL with the group definition unchanged, alongside native effects and unsupported interventions.
measurements.controls: Whole-hidden scaling may use the existing paid, validated linear transport. Partial hidden-coordinate controls are not inferred from whole-hidden scaling.
measurements.frontier: Report the measured cost/local/run tradeoff. Any numerical tolerance grid must be recorded as an explicit evaluation choice, not a universal definition of understanding.

before_each_fit: Save the complete finite expression inventory and all declared language restrictions, including arity, widths, primitive choices, constants and body-size budget
Save initialization, random seed, trainable operator IDs, parameter count, optimizer settings, iteration budget and memory budget
Verify source hashes and save hardware, executable commit and data provenance
State which controls and inventory members are not yet implemented or measured

decision_rules.first_fit: Measure one bounded native-data fit and saved-byte replay before assigning a large compute budget. Record runtime, objective movement and held-out error even if negative.
decision_rules.positive: Shared computation improves a measured fidelity/cost tradeoff against relevant controls, transfers with its body frozen, and predicts native interventions. Inspect what the body and bindings actually encode before assigning an algorithmic interpretation.
decision_rules.negative: Rejected fitted candidates establish failure of those returned programs. They do not prove the whole structural family infeasible or simple native computation absent.
decision_rules.stop_expanding: If the pilot shows no benefit over generic sharing, diagnose representation versus fitting versus intervention support before adding a larger bank of the same proposals.
decision_rules.vpd: This diagnostic alone cannot establish a matched-compute victory over VPD. Account for all candidate fitting and selection compute in a later comparison.
